description: This file contains acceptance test methods for the 'Calls' module within the SuiteCRM project, using Codeception testing framework. It includes setup code and test scenarios for viewing the Calls module and verifying call date functionality.

classes.name: CallsCest
classes.description: Acceptance testing class for the 'Calls' module, providing setup and scenarios to test viewing and interacting with call records.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Setup method executed before each test, initializes Faker for generating fake data and seeds it with a random seed.

methods.name: testScenarioViewCallsModule
methods.description: Test scenario to verify that the Calls module can be viewed by an administrator.

methods.name: testScenarioCallDate
methods.description: Test scenario to create a call record, verify creation, and delete the call, including verifying the date field functionality.
